mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_preferences ( trip_id, source, companion, with_children, with_elderly, pace, discovery_style, dietary_note, preference_text, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{source}, #{companion}, #{withChildren}, #{withElderly}, #{pace}, #{discoveryStyle}, #{dietaryNote}, #{preferenceText}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (trip_id) DO UPDATE SET source = EXCLUDED.source, companion = EXCLUDED.companion, with_children = EXCLUDED.with_children, with_elderly = EXCLUDED.with_elderly, pace = EXCLUDED.pace, discovery_style = EXCLUDED.discovery_style, dietary_note = EXCLUDED.dietary_note, preference_text = EXCLUDED.preference_text, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO trip_preference_tags (trip_id, kind, value) VALUES
(#{tripId}, #{kind}, #{value})
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT trip_id AS tripId, source, companion, with_children AS withChildren, with_elderly AS withElderly, pace, discovery_style AS discoveryStyle, dietary_note AS dietaryNote, preference_text AS preferenceText, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM trip_preferences WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}
SELECT value FROM trip_preference_tags WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND kind = #{kind} ORDER BY value
